config_fields.name: region
config_fields.help: API host region of the store: us (United States), eu (EU/UK sites) or global (Mexico, Japan, …) → https://openapi-b-<region>.temu.com/openapi/router.

fields.name: app_key
fields.help: app_key of your TEMU Partner Platform app (partner.temu.com > App management).

fields.name: app_secret
fields.help: app_secret of the same app; signs every call (upper-case MD5 of app_secret + body parameters sorted by name as name+value + app_secret) and is never sent.

fields.name: access_token
fields.help: The store's access_token from the Seller Center authorisation (Seller Center > open platform > authorise app, or bg.open.accesstoken.create with the callback code); valid about one year (see expiredTime from me).

me.note: bg.open.accesstoken.info.get: the authorised mall (mallId, regionId, mallType), token expiredTime and the API scopes granted.

list_products.note: bg.local.goods.list.query (Product > Manage Products): the STORE'S OWN listings on Temu (a seller API, not a wholesale catalogue), status 1 = available/off the shelf; `query` searches goods name or id, `category` is a Temu catId. SKUs (skuId, stock, specs) are in raw.skuInfoList.

get_product.note: bg.local.goods.detail.query: one listing with skuList (skuId, outSkuSn, specs, retail/list price, images, package weight/volume), properties, size charts and service promise; price/sku are the first SKU's.

get_order.note: bg.order.detail.v2.get by parent order number (PO-…): parentOrderMap (status code, order/confirm/shipping times in epoch seconds, region) and orderList lines (orderSn, goodsId, skuId, quantity, fulfillmentType, packageSnInfo) in raw. Buyer address needs bg.order.shippinginfo.v2.get / decrypt permissions.

not_offered.quote_shipping: Temu is a sales channel: the seller ships Temu's buyer orders; the Partner Platform (https://partner.temu.com/documentation?menu_code=fb16b05f7a904765aac4af3a24b87d4a) has no API that quotes shipping for buying goods.
not_offered.create_order: Orders are placed by Temu shoppers; the Order APIs (bg.order.list.v2.get, bg.order.detail.v2.get, … in https://partner.temu.com/documentation?menu_code=fb16b05f7a904765aac4af3a24b87d4a) read them and no API creates one.
not_offered.track: Tracking is written by the seller through the Fulfillment APIs (bg.logistics.shipment.* in https://partner.temu.com/documentation?menu_code=fb16b05f7a904765aac4af3a24b87d4a); a buyer-side tracking read for an order id alone is not documented.

adapter.terms: TEMU Partner Platform (https://partner.temu.com/documentation?menu_code=38e79b35d2cb463d85619c1c786dd303&sub_menu_code=8311de2b2d434e4d805e88413ab815d8): POST-only JSON gateway https://openapi-b-{us|eu|global}.temu.com/openapi/router; common body parameters type, app_key, access_token, timestamp (unix seconds ±300 s), data_type JSON; sign = upper-case MD5(app_secret + all body parameters sorted by name as name+value, nested values as JSON + app_secret) inserted into the body (https://partner.temu.com/documentation?menu_code=38e79b35d2cb463d85619c1c786dd303&sub_menu_code=4a821c90d06442a09e061b0d4316fbf3).
